Here is what BeautyFlow does for you:

Online booking page: clients see your services, prices and team, and book a time.
Staff commission: every service is tagged to the person who did it, and commission is worked out for you.
Payslips: mark commission paid and your staff see the payslip in their own login.
Staff shifts: plan the week's rota; everyone sees their own shifts.
Discounts & offers: put a service on offer with an end date, or discount a bill at the till.
Reports: top services, busiest days, best staff and profit after commission.
